binary_embedding: strict A in leading 12x12 block of a 16-level four-qubit register; four padding levels set to zero
theorem: The product of four disjoint qubit SWAPs is the global register SWAP and commutes exactly with H tensor I+I tensor H for every identical register Hamiltonian H. For the displayed padded strict encoding, the four individual pairwise-SWAP commutators have a positive numerical Gram spectrum, giving strong evidence that no nonzero static linear combination of those four two-qubit SWAP generators conserves the encoded energy.
